settings.controls_source: E214's built items as E226 and E242 read them (experiments/kstar_vpd_wording_a/results/predictions.json settings reuse/new; random_kl_seed 241002 is E242's KL-matched random, the one E257 read). x2 and x10: layer-1 down_proj columns of E195's eight copy neurons [486, 499, 613, 778, 1125, 2028, 2352, 2960] times 2 and times 10 (rule_retention.rescaled, kstar_levels settings e195_layer/e195_C). new_few and new_thin: known_edits.build's new edits at slot layer 0. The random: E241's Gaussian per decomposed matrix at new_thin's size, scaled so KL(F || M) on new_few's windows matches new_few's at E240's matched size (E242 World.random_kl). Ordered x2, x10 first so the stage-1 stop comes before the rest
settings.kl_saved_source: E226's and E242's item records: kl_fm (KL(F || M) mean over all of D at the read positions), and for the random its kl_target (the KL its scale is matched to)
settings.e62_source: E62's saved weight changes and its own windows file (windows.pt: train split to fit, read split to read, map targets per split), as E231 read them (gain_only recipe 'windows_pt', share_untrained/windows.py load_read)
settings.e231_source: E231's per-state reading of F's trained-answer gain on the same read rows (refs.<task>.states.<state>.gain): each E62 F must repeat it
settings.lr_source: departure from E231's 3e-3 ((IA)^3, Liu et al. 2022): Adam moves a gain by about lr per step, and x10 needs eight neuron gains to travel from 1 to 10; at 3e-3 that takes about 3,000 steps, over the debug QoS's 30 minutes for 28 fits. Measured on a toy net in the CPU dry run (~/commute-data/scratch/compare-lead/gain-share/dry_run.out, dry_run2.out): at 0.05 a toy x10 reached gains 5.6-6.2 of 10 in 600 steps with the loss still falling (KL share 0.976); 0.1 doubles the reach. Whether it finds the best gain is checked by x2 and x10 at N (exactly representable there), with a stop at n_min
settings.schedule_source: linear warm-up over 30 steps (5%), then cosine to 0 at 600 (the common warm-up-cosine schedule, e.g. transformers get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup); a departure from E231's constant rate, which stopped at a variable step: here every fit has a fixed horizon, and the decay lets gains with no signal stop moving. 600 steps: E231's measured 0.031-0.05 s/step (items/*.json s_per_step, its reads included) gives at most about 30 s per fit at N; the run records the train-loss change over its last 100 steps (flat_rel)
settings.batch_source: E231's 32 (ArmAConfig default) doubled: at these sizes a step is overhead-bound, and the larger batch halves the gradient variance on the 38,936 VPD gains
settings.cue_split_source: the 512 cue windows (E214, 8 cues x 64) split into 256 to fit and 256 to read by a permutation with this seed; copy24 and E62 have their own train and held-out splits
settings.rand_source: stage 0's random gain state, gains 1 + 0.05 N(0, 1) at each level: E231's stage-0 construction
settings.stage0_steps_source: the do-nothing fit runs two steps: enough to see whether the loop moves G off F when F = M, at warm-up's small first rates
settings.head_edits_source: E280's edits as experiments/head_edit/run.py (commit b65a8743) builds them: EDITS, `edited`, settings layer 2, head 4, factor 2; head 4's slice is q/v rows and o input columns 512:640. Read here on E62's copy rows (E62's own windows, the trained copy answer at the marker), not E280's D (E257's 8-token windows): stage 3, after stage 2, gated on stage 1

thresholds.thresholds_source: min_gain: E231's MIN_GAIN (commute.local_faith), a share is not read below 1 log-odds of F's gain. kl_min: the KL-recovered share is not read when KL(F || M) is at or under 1e-3 nats, a bar between the do-nothing's exact 0 and the smallest read state's 0.101 (x2, E226 items/x2.json kl_fm); the do-nothing's fit must also land under it. equiv_tol, perm_min: E231's stage-0 bug bars (an fp32 reassociation gives about 1e-6, measured here on CPU at 8.5e-7 for one VPD matrix; a wrong orientation or order gives order 1, the shuffled state measured 1.38). remainder_tol: 10 x the measured fp32 floor of the remainder, |R_fp32 - R_fp64| / |W0| at most 2.85e-7 over the 24 matrices (CPU dry run, ~/commute-data/scratch/compare-lead/gain-share/remainder_floor.out; R + U^T V^T - W0 itself measured at most 1.6e-9); the same bar holds R against the authors' calc_weight_deltas. kl_repro_rel: E221's kl_repro_rel; E226's saved KLs read the featurized model at gains 1, whose relative logit error was at most 2.9e-6 (items gates.all). random_target_rel: E242's kl_rel_tol, the match tolerance that defines the random state. gain_repro_rel: E231's reproduce_rel. n_min: the stop rule below. smallest_gap and low_v: the card's

readings.share: per (state, level): (mean over held-out rows of the trained answer's log-odds at its position under G*, minus under M) / (the same for F), read only where F's gain is at least min_gain; log-odds as steering.logodds_at
readings.kl_fg: KL(F || G*) at the rows' KL positions, mean over held-out rows (rule_retention.kl, fp64); also on the train rows (train_kl_fg)
readings.kl_share: 1 - KL(F || G*) / KL(F || M) on the held-out rows, read where KL(F || M) > kl_min
readings.positions: E62: the read position half (20), fed whole 41-token windows as E62 and E231 fed them; x2, x10: every position of copy24's 41-token windows for KL (as E214 read them), the copy table's answer at half; cue items: the last position
readings.split: E62: windows.pt train split to fit, read split to read; x2, x10: copy24's train split to fit, its 75 held-out windows (E214's D) to read; cue items: 256 of E214's 512 cue windows to fit, the other 256 to read

blind_to: Which of M's variables carry G*'s gain (the share is one number per state). A gain-only fit that reaches F's answer by a route F does not take reads as recovered; the KL share and KL(F || G*) show how far G* is from F on the whole next-token distribution at the read positions. At V, a gain on a subcomponent scales its whole rank-one write across heads, so a one-head change is representable only as far as some setting of the shared subcomponents rebuilds it: that is what rival b tests. Overfitting of the 38,936 V gains shows as train KL well under held-out KL, reported per fit.
positive_control: x2 and x10 at N: exactly a gain of 2 or 10 on eight neurons, so the best gain-only fit recovers all of F; at least 0.95 expected, under n_min stops the job

expected.stage0: gains of 1: logits bit-identical to M's at both levels, exported change exactly 0; VPD remainder identity and agreement with the authors' remainder at most 3e-6 relative; random gain state: export within 1e-3 (about 1e-6), shuffled over 0.1 (about 1); do-nothing (F = M): KL(F || M) and F's gain exactly 0, KL(F || G*) at most kl_min after its two steps
expected.x2_x10: N: share and KL share at least 0.95; V: about 1 (0.7 to 1.05), the reading: E257's kept share for x2 was 0.761 at the same featurization
expected.random: KL share at most 0.2 at both levels (no task answer, so no share)
expected.new_few_new_thin: share at most 0.3 at both levels: the edits write a new input direction no gain on M's variables makes
expected.e62_N: copy about 0.85, lookup about 0.6 (prior: E231's gain-only training on the task, not on KL to F, reached 0.87 and 0.63 of the fine-tunes' mean gain, items/e62_*_s*.json); copy above lookup by at least 0.1
expected.e62_V: rival a: copy above lookup by at least 0.1; rival b: both under 0.3 and within 0.1
expected.e280_head_edits: o2 at N: at least 0.95 (exactly a head gain of 2 on o_proj's input); v2 at N: at least 0.95 (doubling head 4's value rows doubles its z, the same function as o2); q2 at N: under 0.95 (doubling attention logits sharpens the head's pattern, which no o_proj head gain or neuron gain expresses); at V: v2 and o2 under their N readings, between 0.2 and 0.9 (no layer-2 subcomponent is mostly head 4's: the largest head-4 share of a subcomponent's weight is 0.74, the median 0.115, 2026-11-23 diagnosis), q2 at V under v2 at V. A state whose F gains under 1 log-odds on the copy rows is read by its KL share. Descriptive: no stop and no rule reads them
expected.fit_flat: flat_rel (train-loss change between the last two checks, relative) under 0.05 on most fits; descriptive

rules.stop_stage1: after x2 and after x10: at N, every reading it has (share where read, KL share where read) at least n_min (0.9), else the job stops (exit 1) and stage 2 does not run: the fit is not finding the best gain
rules.gap: per level L: gap_L = mean over read seeds of copy's share minus mean over read seeds of lookup's share (seeds 0-2); a side with no read seed gives gap_L 'not read'
rules.P_N: gap_N >= smallest_gap (0.1): the share separates copy from lookup at neurons and heads
rules.P_V: gap_V >= smallest_gap (0.1): it separates them at VPD
rules.verdict: rival a if P_N and P_V; rival b if P_N, both V means under low_v (0.3) and |gap_V| under smallest_gap; else 'neither rival' with the four means reported; any gap not read gives 'no call'
rules.stop_line: the card's stop: gap_N under smallest_gap (copy and lookup read within 0.1 at neurons and heads too) ends option 2 past this prototype

edge_cases.zero_denominator: F's gain under min_gain (including 0) -> share None, the state is read by its KL share only; KL(F || M) at or under kl_min -> KL share None; the do-nothing reads both None
edge_cases.one_state: a side with one read seed: its mean is that seed's share; the gap is still computed and the report says n = 1
edge_cases.no_state: a side with no read seed: gap 'not read', the verdict 'no call'
edge_cases.ties: gaps and means are compared after rounding to 12 decimals, so a float subtraction cannot break a tie; a gap exactly 0.1 counts as separating (>=); a V mean exactly 0.3 does not count as under low_v (<); |gap_V| exactly 0.1 is not under smallest_gap
edge_cases.share_over_1_or_negative: read as it is (G* may overshoot F's answer, or move it the wrong way); not clipped
edge_cases.nan: a nan share or KL share counts as not read
